title: Applying Standards to Advance Upstream & Downstream Ethics in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not perform a benchmark measurement. It cites an external finding that a Reddit dataset used for training an LLM encoded discriminatory views based on religion.
findings: The paper cites external research [43] indicating that training datasets (e.g., from Reddit) can encode discriminatory views based on religion. This is used as an example to highlight the risks of using uncurated datasets and the need for upstream ethical safeguards.
